home.name: Joey Daccord
home.news: In recent seasons, Daccord's strong play has made him the more reliable option in Seattle's crease, but the 2026-27 season has not been fruitful. The 30-year-old goalie has not played in over a week, allowing four goals on 14 shots (.714 SV%) in a 5-1 loss to the Carolina Hurricanes. Seattle has lost five of the past six games he has appeared in (1-5-0), posting a dreadful 3.07 GAA and .837 SV%. Still, Seattle enters Monday's game as slight -118 home favourites against an Anaheim Ducks team on a three-game losing streak (0-3-0).

away.name: Filip Gustavsson
away.news: Gustavsson was recalled from Iowa on Monday after a one-game conditioning stint, in which he recorded a win while saving 29 of 32 shots (.906 SV%), marking his first game since his off-season hip surgery. The 27-year-old Gustavsson is entering the first year of a five-year, $38 million contract extension ($6.8 million AAV) and is poised to compete for playing time with counterpart Jesper Wallstedt, who has become Minnesota's de facto starting goalie and one of the NHL's top goalies this season. Minnesota enters Monday's matchup as -170 road favourites against the San Jose Sharks, who are 4-1-1 in their past six games.

home.name: Yaroslav Askarov
home.news: Askarov had a rough performance in his most recent outing, allowing 24 of shots (.857 SV%) in a 5-2 loss to the Calgary Flames. The 24-year-old goalie has been inconsistent this season, allowing four or more goals in seven of 16 games (6-9-1). The Sharks enter Monday's contest as +153 home underdogs against a Minnesota Wild team that is without Quinn Hughes (upper body) and is coming off a 4-3 loss to the Vancouver Canucks.
